g.text: Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

The server list is 260px, or a third of the width if that is smaller, with a vertical rule beside it. Each open session is a tab over the built-in terminal, which is a child window and not a separate one.
Reconnect is enabled only when the session is closed. ✕ closes the session and asks 'Disconnect from X?' if it is still live. The header ⟳ reads the project's SSH servers again.

With no session open, the right side shows 'No open sessions — Click a server on the left to open an SSH session here…'. Without an Admin token the tab shows 'The SSH servers are read from Settings, which needs an Admin token…'.
Right-clicking the terminal offers Copy (Ctrl+Shift+C), Paste (Ctrl+Shift+V), Select all and Clear scrollback.
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
